scope: Actual Mandalorian Armor deployment and transfer with Force measurements at deployment phase, source departure, both represented Vader exclusions, and two actual Obi-Wan lightsaber attacks.
Six modifier observations install production armor definitions/additions before or after actual card deployment; native independently executes the deployment and query.

differences.adjudication: AR p28 Resets - Examples explicitly says Mandalorian Armor defines modifiable armor on a previously unarmored character. Existing armor instead receives an unmodifiable reset. Pinned Card5_109 always supplies ResetArmorModifier. Native follows the explicit official example.

limitations: Current ground Character context. Crossing-over, persona replacement, inactive/captured/aboard states, text cancellation and general providers remain incomplete.

Transfer into existing armor, original-instance checks, Comlink react/cancellation, damage threshold and saved-state validation have native regression tests; not all have individually executed GEMP cases.
Turn modifiers are controlled fixture providers; this is not full granting-card or deck admission.
Full native matches remain gated and the broader engine objective remains unfinished.
